outcome: Maternal Postpartum Stress Scale (MPSS) factor structure
scores on MPSS subscales (Personal needs and fatigue, Infant nurturing, Body changes and sexuality)
cohort: A total of 603 postpartum women participated in an online study during the first postpartum year.
finding: The Maternal Postpartum Stress Scale (MPSS) was developed and validated as a new, reliable, and valid 22-item scale with a three-factor structure to measure stress during the first postpartum year.
